Strategy: Give a bonus to placements whose leftover is at least half of the loosest residual, tying the reward to the current spread rather than a fixed number. It may help by adapting to wide states, but may fail when the loosest bin is an outlier that distorts the threshold.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= max(bins) / 2 else 0) for r in bins]
```
